title: Feasibility Studies
description: Evaluate whether a proposed solution is viable. Tests feasibility assessment, options analysis, and weighted scoring.

seo.overviewTitle: Feasibility Studies & TELOS Framework Risk Assessment
seo.overviewBody: Feasibility studies evaluate whether a proposed project is viable before committing resources. Business analysts use the TELOS framework (Technical, Economic, Legal, Operational, Schedule), construct 5x5 risk matrices, and present Go / No-Go decision recommendations.

deliverables.title: 1. Comprehensive Feasibility Study Report (TELOS)
deliverables.desc: Formal feasibility document evaluating Technical, Economic, Legal, Operational, and Schedule viability.

deliverables.title: 2. Probability & Impact Risk Assessment Matrix
deliverables.desc: 5x5 risk matrix scoring project risks by probability and severity alongside mitigation strategies.

deliverables.title: 3. Go / No-Go Decision Recommendation Brief
deliverables.desc: Executive recommendation brief outlining project viability tradeoffs and critical success prerequisites.

faqs.question: What does the TELOS feasibility framework evaluate?
faqs.answer: Technical (is technology available?), Economic (is it cost-effective?), Legal (does it comply with law/POPIA?), Operational (will the business adopt it?), Schedule (can it be built in time?).

faqs.question: How does a 5x5 Risk Probability-Impact Matrix work?
faqs.answer: Risks are scored from 1 to 5 on Likelihood and 1 to 5 on Severity; multiplying both gives a Risk Score (1-25) to prioritize mitigation focus.

faqs.question: What defines a clear Go / No-Go decision checkpoint?
faqs.answer: A milestone where executive sponsors review feasibility findings against predefined success criteria to approve continuation or cancel the initiative.
